subject.title: [Bug]: Signal DM silently dropped on reply session initialization conflict (retry fix ported to Slack/Telegram but not Signal)

question: Which open branch should be treated as the canonical Signal retry fix for this issue?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but there are multiple open candidates and at least one candidate still needs real Signal proof before maintainers should land a delivery-path change.

options.title: Use the mergeable Signal retry PR after proof
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101533 as the current best candidate if it gets redacted live Signal/gateway proof and focused side-effect coverage.

options.title: Repair or replace the conflicting candidate
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101267 in consideration only if it is rebased, proof-positive, and no longer conflicts.

options.title: Defer to the generic self-heal work only
options.body: If maintainers decide the shared self-heal fully covers Signal loss, require proof that Signal debounce failures are preserved before closing the channel-specific issue.

recommendation.title: Use the mergeable Signal retry PR after proof
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101533 as the current best candidate if it gets redacted live Signal/gateway proof and focused side-effect coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and prior Signal retry review context make this the best available routing candidate for choosing the canonical Signal fix branch.
